description: Mittelspannungsnetz Stadtwerke Winsen (Luhe) GmbH is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The medium-voltage network includes all 20KV cables with the transformer stations as well as the control cables of the city of Winsen (Luhe) and its districts. The data is always kept up-to-date in a geographical information system and can be requested in the form of pdf or dxf/dwg files. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Medium-voltage grid Stadtwerke Winsen (Luhe) GmbH" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Produktions- und Industrieanlagen, Stromnetz, Versorgungsunternehmen, Mittelspannung, Trafostation, Steuerkabel. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
